subject: KPI readout & QBR prep — May dashboard + action grid
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Nora Patel <nora@brightbox.com>
Date: Fri, May 5, 2028 at 08:23 AM -0700
Subject: May monthly KPI dashboard (draft) + ask for QBR items
Attachments: 20280505-monthly-kpi-dash.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Team / Nora,

Attached is the draft May dashboard I pulled together for the monthly leadership readout. High level notes up front:
- Latency: p95 increased from 112ms -> 156ms this month; bursty at times for several Hosted routes.
- Cost: token spend up 9% month-over-month driven by a single high-throughput customer (BrightBox).
- Uptime: 99.92% (two brief infra incidents on 4/12 and 4/27) — impacting some Dedicated tenants.
- Usage: daily active routes up 18% YOY; median request size steady.

As we prep for the May QBR (week of May 15), ask list: 
1) Vivek — short root-cause summary for the p95 increase + immediate mitigations (due Tue 5/9 EOD).
2) Lauren — annotate the cost breakout sheet with customer-level drivers and suggested throttles/fallbacks (due Wed 5/10 10am).
3) Markus — confirm whether the 4/27 incident requires a postmortem slide and list owners for follow-ups (due Mon 5/8).
4) Laura — consolidate a 2-slide exec summary we can include in the QBR deck (due Thu 5/11).

Nora / BrightBox — I flagged a BrightBox spike in the cost tab; if you'd like to join a 30m sync on customer usage prior to QBR, propose Wed 5/10 11am PT.

I'll iterate the sheet over the next 48 hours. Please add quick comments in the "notes" column on the workbook rather than sending separate threads — keeps the record clean.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Ops Reporting | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
(Attachment: 20280505-monthly-kpi-dash.xlsx)

Thanks Jonas — looked through the sheet this morning. Quick inline: 

On Fri, May 5, 2028 at 08:23 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai> wrote:
> - Latency: p95 increased from 112ms -> 156ms this month; bursty at times for several Hosted routes.

Agree we should call this out, but recommend framing as two buckets: planner/regression vs traffic-pattern-driven.

Comments I added to the workbook: 
- Slide 1 (exec summary): shorten the latency language and add one bullet on our expected mitigations to avoid sounding alarmist.
- Slide 2 (ops detail): add trendline for KV-cache hit rates — that maps to the p95.

Markus: if you confirm 4/27 was a capacity scheduling lapse (vs infra bug), we can include a one-line corrective action and put the detailed follow-up into the infra PMs backlog.

I'll draft the two-slide summary and post to the Drive link by EOD Thu (5/11). Jonas, will you take point on the QBR slide deck compilation?

—Laura

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Nora Patel <nora@brightbox.com>
Date: Tue, May 9, 2028 at 14:05 -0700
Subject: Re: May monthly KPI dashboard (draft) + ask for QBR items

Brief root cause and immediate actions on latency (summary for the dashboard):

Findings:
- Primary driver: a single high-throughput route with requests that bypassed prefix caching due to an upstream client header change (BrightBox SDK 3.9 shipped 4/24).
- Secondary driver: a scheduling gap on Dedicated pool B during the Apr 27 maintenance window, which amplified p95 for affected tenants.

Immediate mitigations (already in motion):
- Ops: added a temporary request-level cache rule for the affected route (rolled out 5/8 02:00 UTC) — expected to reduce p95 by ~25% for those requests; monitoring green on sampling.
- Infra: added two reserved slots to Dedicated pool B for the next 72 hours to reduce scheduling churn (5/9 05:00 UTC).
- Product: reached out to BrightBox to coordinate a patch to the SDK that preserves caching headers (cc: Nora).

Next steps (deliverables):
- Vivek: 800-word RCA + small chart pack for the ops appendix (due Thu 5/11 12:00).
- Jonas: add the RCA summary into the QBR appendix and flag any residual risk items.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Site Reliability | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
(Attachment: latency-slo-breakdown.pdf)

Subject: KPI readout & QBR prep — May dashboard + action grid

Thanks all — pulling this into a concise action grid for the QBR slides. Finalized items below; please confirm owner & ETA inline.

Action grid (final):
1) RCA summary and chart pack for ops appendix — Owner: Vivek — Due: 2028-05-11T12:00:00-07:00 (received) — Status: attached to thread (latency-slo-breakdown.pdf).
2) Cost-breakdown per-customer with suggested throttles/fallbacks — Owner: Lauren — Due: 2028-05-10T10:00:00-07:00 — Status: Lauren noted updates in workbook.
3) Confirm incident classification for 4/27 + postmortem owner list — Owner: Markus — Due: 2028-05-08T17:00:00-07:00 — Status: Markus to publish PM follow-ups to infra backlog.
4) 2-slide exec summary for QBR deck — Owner: Laura — Due: 2028-05-11T17:00:00-07:00 — Status: Laura to upload to Drive link.
5) Customer sync (BrightBox) re SDK header change — Owner: Jonas / Nora — Target: 2028-05-10T11:00:00-07:00 — Status: proposed; Nora to confirm.
6) Update runbook for cache rules and Dedicated pool scaling — Owner: SRE runbook team (cc Markus) — Due: 2028-05-14 — Status: in flight.

QBR logistics: I'll assemble the 10-min ops readout and share final deck on Drive by Mon 5/13 09:00 PT. Laura, please confirm the two-slide exec summary by EOD tonight; Nora, please confirm whether Samir should be on the BrightBox sync.

Thanks — good cross-functional work here.

Jonas
